title: Mollified indicators are uniformly bounded and uniformly Lipschitz
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let ρ : ℝⁿ → ℝ be C¹ with compact support, ρ ≥ 0 and ∫ ρ dL = 1. Then there is L ∈ ℝ such that for every Borel set F ⊆ ℝⁿ the function v_F(x) := ∫ ρ(y)·1_F(x − y) dy satisfies |v_F(x)| ≤ L and |v_F(x) − v_F(x')| ≤ L·|x − x'| for all x, x' ∈ ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ρ : Euclid n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ρ y) → ∫ y, ρ y = 1 → ∃ L : ℝ, ∀ F : Set (Euclid n), MeasurableSet F → (∀ x, |∫ y, ρ y * F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (x - y)| ≤ L) ∧ ∀ x x', |(∫ y, ρ y * F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (x - y)) - ∫ y, ρ y * F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (x' - y)| ≤ L * ‖x - x'‖
